accepted_observation.observed_scope: Title click, visible li center, narrow toggle-anchor center, and corrected narrow toggle-anchor Enter; the anchor center and Enter remained collapsed while title and li interactions expanded.

markup: A real li.news-toggle contains an anchor whose href is javascript:toggleEntry('7-30-07-513','').
The nearest parent with class hoverContainer has onclick javascript:toggleEntry('7-30-07-513','').
The narrow anchor is 14px wide by 1px high in the browser; its parent li is 14px by 11px.

real_source_preview.command: Bundled Python in-memory call to rewrite_news_toggle_anchors on the three V12 RSS source files; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; no output files written.
real_source_preview.interpretation: The marker count is one greater than matched_anchors because the derived style selector also contains the anchor marker; stopPropagation attribute count equals matched anchor count.

derived_contract.matcher: Only an anchor inside an ancestor li.news-toggle is eligible when its normalized javascript:toggleEntry(...) href equals the normalized toggleEntry(...) onclick of its nearest ancestor carrying class hoverContainer.
derived_contract.function_identifier: toggleEntry is case-sensitive and must match exactly; ToggleEntry or another identifier is rejected.
derived_contract.javascript_scheme: The javascript scheme spelling is case-insensitive, while the function identifier remains exact; href still must carry the javascript: prefix.
derived_contract.argument_shape: Exactly two simple quoted arguments are accepted: entry id [A-Za-z0-9_-]+ and alt [A-Za-z0-9_-]*. Outer syntax whitespace is accepted; string contents, case, and tuple values are preserved. Composite expressions, extra arguments, and internal string whitespace are rejected.
derived_contract.parent_shape: The nearest hoverContainer onclick may omit or include the javascript: prefix, but must use the exact toggleEntry identifier and equal argument tuple.
derived_contract.fast_return: If news-toggle and toggleEntry tokens are absent, the function returns before HTML tokenization.
derived_contract.existing_anchor_handlers: Anchors with an existing onclick are left unchanged; title h1 anchors, ordinary li centers, other JavaScript links, forms, and unrelated markup are not rewritten.
derived_contract.anchor_change: The matched anchor receives onclick=event.stopPropagation(); and data-archive-derived="news-toggle-anchor-v1"; its original href remains unchanged so the historical default action runs once.
derived_contract.hit_area: A single derived style block targets only .news-toggle a[data-archive-derived="news-toggle-anchor-v1"] with display:block, width:14px, and height:11px.
explicit_exclusions: No whole-row handler or form changes
No frozen source or image payload changes
derived_contract.idempotence: A second rewrite finds the marker and returns identical text with zero new matches.

case-insensitive javascript scheme with exact case-sensitive toggleEntry negative
